title: qxmd219: open Marks Settings from gear; fix sol prose KaTeX jam; Allen foot pad
body: Gear opens full Marks Question View Settings (Examgoal+Allen). SOLUTION prose stays text (not KaTeX mathnormal). Text size S/M/L/XL scales stem+options+solution. Allen fixed Prev|Check|Next padded; transparent dark foot; no palette peek. Tools in Settings only.
